text:
Sarah L: Heads up — new NVD entry CVE-2026-0912. Affects protobuf-c native extension that our runtime pulls in via wheels. Initial indicators: CVSS 8.1, EPSS 0.45, public claim of a PoC on GH.
security-bot: nvd-feed: CVE-2026-0912 added 2026-03-20T09:12Z — refs: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-0912
Priya K: I'll take triage. Quick ask: which services use the vulnerable wheel directly vs via our internal vendored bundle? Need an impact matrix.
Riley M: runtime + dedicated GPU pools include the wheel in container build. Private on-prem images may have older pinned wheels. Also check our inference-worker image tags.
Alina P: Priority checklist: (1) owner, (2) exploitability check, (3) RBAC/KMS blast radius, (4) rollout plan. I can pull audit logs for KMS calls.
Jon T: Initial exploitability: PoC claims RCE by crafted message parsing. If true, any service that accepts untrusted payloads and deserializes could be affected. Marking tentative severity: high.
Priya K: Quick smoke steps I'm running locally:
```bash
pip3 show protobuf
python -c "import google.protobuf; print(google.protobuf.__version__)"
# run unit tests against deserialization harness
```
Priya K: Results: our hosted runtime image uses protobuf 4.2.0 (vulnerable range). Dedicated infra has mixed versions, some pinned to 4.1.x.
Riley M: RBAC question: If exploit achieves code exec, can it reach KMS? Our runtime process runs in pod with AWS IAM role via IRSA that allows Decrypt on model keys. We need to limit that surface.
Alina P: Action: collect CloudTrail + KMS audit logs for decrypt/Encrypt/GenerateDataKey in last 72h for the runtime role. Also snapshot role policies.
security-bot: cloudtrail-search: found 14 decrypt calls from runtime-role in last 24h, 3 from ephemeral batch jobs.
Priya K: Scoring update: CVSS 8.1 (AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H). EPSS 0.45. Exploit chatter: low-confidence PoC. Recommendation: P1 for runtime ingestion path, P2 for internal-only tools.
Jon T: Mitigations: short-term — build image with patched protobuf 4.3.1 and push to canary. Medium — add input sanitization and stricter user input isolation. Long — move KMS decrypt calls behind a narrow service with additional auth.
Riley M: RBAC change proposal: remove runtime role's direct Decrypt privilege for model keys. Introduce kms-proxy service with limited API and ephemeral credentials. That reduces blast radius.
Alina P: Can we rotate the model key as a precaution? That will require re-encrypting model artifacts and downtime for private deployments.
Priya K: I'd prefer roll-forward patch instead of emergency key rotation unless we see evidence of key misuse. For now: patch build + canary, audit logs, and temp increase in alerting.
deploy-bot: Canary created: canary-protobuf-2141589000 — image: rwd-runtime:patch-protobuf-4.3.1 — started 2026-03-20T11:05Z
Sarah L: Timeline suggestion: patch canary now, monitor 2h. If stable, rolling canary to 10% for 1h, then full rollout overnight (02:00 UTC) in maintenance window. If any sign of exploit, rollback and escalate.
Jon T: Also add an eval: run corpus of common user inputs through patched image to check for regressions in tokenization/deserialization.
Priya K: Owners: Priya (triage + tests), Riley (RBAC/KMS impact + rollout gating), Alina (audit + logs), Jon (exploit verification). I'll open a GH issue and link tracker.
Sarah L: Good. Please post quick status updates in this thread. :thumbsup:
Priya K: Opening tracker now — https://github.com/redwood-inference/security/issues/842
Riley M: I'll start drafting an RBAC change and a runbook for kms-proxy.
Alina P: Pulling audit logs now, will paste notable entries if anything anomalous.
security-bot: alert: increased monitoring rule enabled for runtime-role decrypts — threshold 5/minute.
Priya K: Thanks all — will post triage summary after the canary stabilizes.
